A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work by the same authors. Full-text comparison and rendered-page inspection cover all 44 pages in each version, including equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–G, without material reading gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original PDE-solving and pendulum-control experiments in Section 6 and Appendix G, including numerical accuracy, runtime and control-cost results.

after.justification: v3 retains the original experimental outcomes in Section 6 and Appendix G, including Tables 1–4 and the experimental plots.

M1.justification: The Stratonovich formulation, stochastic Heun integration, self-consistency losses and full/batched procedures in Algorithms 1–3 are unchanged. Replacing 'backwards' with 'backward' does not alter the method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same HJB, Black-Scholes-Barenblatt and fully coupled Bender–Zhang problems, dimensionality scenarios and pendulum swing-up task. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments: PINNs, FS-PINNs, EM-BSDE and, where included, EM-BSDE (NR). The full and batched comparisons retain the same participants.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendix G retain the same evaluation procedures, RL2 metric, five evaluation trajectories, default T = 1 and N = 50, training configurations and experimental controls.

E4.justification: The discretization and skip-length studies, runtime comparisons, floating-point sensitivity analysis, dimensionality study and pendulum error maps are retained unchanged in Section 6 and Appendix G.

E5.justification: Table 1 still reports averages over three initialization seeds with one standard deviation. Uncertainty displays and statistical estimation information elsewhere are also unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 and Figures 1–8 retain their numerical entries and plotted results. For example, the full-algorithm Heun-BSDE RL2 error on 100D HJB remains 0.0493 ± 0.0109 in Table 1.

T1.justification: Equation (4.10), in Section 4.2 and its Appendix D.3 restatement, gains brackets explicitly enclosing the squared residual inside the expectation. The v2 proof already uses that expected squared residual, so this clarifies notation without changing the theorem, assumptions or reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about persistent Euler-Maruyama bias, its removal through Heun integration, multi-step trade-offs and competitiveness with PINNs.

C2.justification: The result interpretations and Appendix A limitations are unchanged, including computational overhead, floating-point sensitivity, parity with FS-PINNs and the theoretical exclusions concerning intermediate horizons and fully coupled systems.

D1.justification: Appendix G retains the same architecture, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, batch sizes, hardware, precision and implementation descriptions. Section 6 provides the same code-repository link.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix B and the reference list retain the same cited works and research positioning. No relationships to prior PINNs or BSDE methods are added or revised.

P1.justification: v3 replaces 'Backwards' with 'Backward' in the title and makes corresponding terminology edits throughout the text. It also updates the revision date and arXiv version marking; section order and narrative structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The terminology edits cause limited local line reflow, and the added expectation brackets slightly change the display of Equation (4.10) in two places. Figures, tables, captions and their placement are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 makes small terminology and notation refinements. The intended expectation in Theorem 4.4 was already explicit in v2's proof, and the scientific content, empirical evidence, limitations and reproducibility information remain unchanged. These editorial adjustments have a negligible effect on overall paper quality.
